description:
Kang Woo-jin, a new employee who joined the planning department of KV Video, a video company, is a young man who can't use his legs when it comes to OO videos. Woo-jin succeeds in getting a job on the KV video he has been dreaming of and cheers for a job where he can live buried in OO videos, but his boss, Nam Si-woo's rudeness is not so difficult. Inconvenient and difficult boss. Knowing about your boss will help you in your work life. With that thought in mind, Woo-Jin touches Nam Si-Woo's past works placed in the corner of the company warehouse. However, what Woojin, who expected to be a project related to Nam Si-woo, saw a video in which Si-woo appeared. Woo-jin, who first saw Si-woo's OO video. In Woojin’s head, the image of Siwoo he saw in the video doesn’t leave, and Siwoo, who was just a rough boss, starts to feel uncomfortable in a different way… .
